svg.title: Refinement toward an independently derived relaxation solution
svg.desc: The two compartments have constant compliances0.01 and0.04L/mmHg, an open valve resistance2 and initial pressures20 and5. Their pressure difference decays exponentially. Three backward-Euler steps approach the exact upstream pressure.
